name: polymarket-arb-bot
description: Polymarket 5-minute crypto market arbitrage bot - exploits price delays between exchanges and Polymarket

scripts.dev: concurrently -n bot,dashboard -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev:bot" "npm run dev:dashboard"
scripts.reset:full: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const d='data'; ['session.json','trades.json','historical-markets.json','logs.json'].forEach(f=>{ try { fs.rmSync(d+'/'+f,{force:true}); console.log('Removed '+d+'/'+f); } catch(e) {} }); console.log('Full reset done. Stop the bot first, then start again for a clean slate with DEMO_STARTING_BALANCE.');"
